Meanwhile, the Galaxy S26 series and the Pixel 11 lineup are also on sale. The Apple iPhone Duo is available for pre-order from the Apple UK website and starts at £1,999 for the 256GB model. description: According to Digital Chat Station on Weibo, the upcoming iQOO Z12 Turbo will have a 6.59-inch "ultra-high refresh rate" screen, and will be powered by the upcoming chipset that will either be called Snapdragon 8 Gen 6 or Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 Pro. description: Honor unveiled MagicOS 11 based on Android 17 last month, and today the company has finally revealed when the stable update will reach existing devices. Don't expect anything too clear, though. As you can see below, the company's arm in the UK has just dumped a huge list of supported devices into a post on X, saying it would update all of them to MagicOS 11 between this month and March next year. title: Moto G47 Power is coming with a much larger battery than the G47
description: Motorola launched the Moto G47 in April, and interestingly, the company is now readying not a successor, but a new member of the Moto G47 family - the Moto G47 Power. [#InlinePriceWidget,14645,1#] Motorola has published its European Energy Label documentation, and this reveals that the phone comes with a battery rated at 6,790 mAh. That will most likely be advertised by Motorola as a typical capacity of 6,900 or 7,000 mAh. And it's a big boost compared to the G47's 5,200 mAh battery. title: If you haven't pre-ordered an iPhone Duo yet, you're in for a long, long wait
description: The Apple iPhone Duo is available for pre-order starting today – or rather we should say that it was available. The very limited supply became painfully apparent when mere hours after launching, Apple’s online store was already showing a shipping date of January 22. The original plan was for the iPhone Duo to start shipping on October 23 after a week of pre-orders. And some people will surely get theirs on that date, but most Duo buyers are in for a wait. title: Samsung Galaxy S27+ might miss out on UWB
description: According to new MIIT (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology) listings in China, the Samsung Galaxy S27+ will miss out on a connectivity feature that has been around since the days of the Galaxy S21+, and that's UWB. The Galaxy S27 series is expected to include 4 phones: Galaxy S27, S27+, S27 Pro and S27 Ultra. The MIIT listing reveals all four models, but only the Pro and the Ultra are listed to support UWB. description: We already know when Apple will show off its touchscreen MacBooks and the OLED iPad mini thanks to a leak from yesterday, and now the company itself seems to have confirmed the tablet is coming. A new Smart Folio for the iPad mini with the model number A3632 has shown up on Apple's French regulatory website, and that number doesn't match any iPad mini case Apple has sold so far. The listing was added recently, alongside accessories for the iPhone 18 Pro that went up in September. The document is dated September 9, although it's unclear exactly when it went live. title: The Galaxy S27 Ultra runs into issues with the Snapdragon 8 EE Gen 6, Exynos 2700 may return
description: The Exynos 2700 reportedly beat the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 in internal benchmarks, outscoring it in multi-core Geekbench by around 10%. However, it may have another advantage – running cooler. In a flashback to the Snapdragon 8 Gen 1, the new Elite Extreme Gen 6 runs too hot for Samsung’s liking, according to industry insiders quoted by SEDaily. During testing of the upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, Samsung found that the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 exceeded temperature thresholds and started throttling during heavy sustained loads. description: We’ve been hearing a lot about the OnePlus Ace 7 series over the past few days. Both the Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro were recently also spotted on Google’s Supported Devices list. Now, a tipster has revealed key camera details about the upcoming phones. According to tipster Digital Chat Station, both the OnePlus Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro will feature a 200MP main rear camera. Previous leaks had also hinted at this upgrade, but it was unclear whether the camera would be exclusive to the Pro model. The OnePlus Ace 6 featured a 50MP main rear camera. description: vivo unveiled the X500 family in China last month, and it's already revealed that the European launch event will take place on October 27. A new leak today tells us about the devices' European prices, but there's a twist - apparently, only two of the three models will be available in Europe. The 'vanilla' X500 may not be launching in Europe at all. There's a slim chance it could be coming later on, but according to a usually reliable source, it won't land at the same time as the X500 Pro and the X500 Pro Max. title: Sony bails on Xperia 10 VI’s Android 17 update
description: The Xperia 10 VI launched in May of 2024, booting Android 14, and at the time Sony pledged the device would be eligible for three Android updates. That meant that it would get Android 17 at some point, but that promise will not be kept as Sony has now issued a notice to its users. As per Sony, the Xperia 10 VI will not be getting Android 17 due to “limitations related to the device’s storage configuration”. description: The Tecno Spark 50 series includes three smartphones - the Spark 50 4G, the Spark 50 5G, and the Spark 50 Pro. title: Redmi K100 confirmed to launch this month, Redmi Clip Neo to tag along
description: The Redmi K100 Pro and K100 Pro Max went official in China in August. Xiaomi has now confirmed that the base Redmi K100 will launch later this month. The handset is rumored to be powered by the older Snapdragon 8 Elite SoC. In a post on its official Weibo account, Redmi teased the silhouette of the Redmi K100 and confirmed that it will be unveiled this month. Pre-orders for the phone are also live in China. description: Apple unveiled the iPhone Duo last month alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. While the iPhone 18 Pro models went on pre-order the same week and are already on sale, the iPhone Duo will go on pre-order today at 12 PM UTC. The iPhone Duo will be available for pre-orders through Apple's official website and Apple Store app in over 70 countries and regions, including Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, Colombia, France, Germany, India, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, Singapore, South Korea, Turkey, the UAE, the UK, the US, and Vietnam. description: Honor is set to unveil the Win2 series on October 21, and a tipster on X has now shared what look like its first Geekbench runs. description: Alongside the iQOO 16, the iQOO Pad Ultra was unveiled at the end of September as an 8.8-inch gaming tablet powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and the company's Q4 gaming chip. Now the brand is teasing a sibling that keeps much of that formula. Today on Weibo, iQOO confirmed more details for the Pad Pro 8.8. description: Samsung launched the Galaxy F70e back in February and the Galaxy F70 Pro in August, and the vanilla Galaxy F70 showed up in Google's database last week. title: Xreal 1 Pro+ launches with brighter display and same price as predecessor
description: Xreal’s latest pair of AR glasses brings some big improvements on the display front while keeping the same $599 starting price. The key upgrade on the brand-new Xreal 1 Pro+ is its 1200 nits peak brightness, which is up from 700 nits on its predecessor. The new model now supports 60fps 2D to 3D conversion, up from 30fps on the Xreal 1 Pro, and this should directly translate to livelier spatial content. title: Samsung Galaxy A38's camera details surface
description: Yesterday, we learned that the Samsung Galaxy A58, expected to arrive next March or April, will feature the same camera setup as the Galaxy A57, at least in terms of resolution. The same source has now shared details about the Galaxy A38's cameras. The source claims that the Samsung Galaxy A38 will feature a 50MP primary camera, a 12MP ultrawide camera, a 5MP macro camera, and a 12MP selfie camera.
